title: Hidden ecosystem: Scientists discover 245 animals living inside a single deep-sea rock
caption:
Deep-sea rocks aren't just minerals—they are thriving, hidden ecosystems. Researchers found thousands of tiny animals living inside nodules that take millions of years to form, raising major concerns about the impact of deep-sea mining.

Source: Sciencedaily - Hidden ecosystem: Scientists discover 245 animals living inside a single deep-sea rock
